name: Vapi
tagline: A developer platform for building, testing and deploying voice AI agents for phone calls.
about: Vapi handles the pipeline behind a voice agent: speech-to-text, the language model and text-to-speech, plus telephony.
pros: Handles speech-to-text, the model and text-to-speech in one pipeline.
Works with many voice and model providers.
cons: Per-minute costs add up across providers.
Needs development work to set up well.
